subject: social_studies
concept: Writing an evidence-based legal analysis essay applying due process, punishment theory, and civil/criminal distinctions to a real-world scenario, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their essay using a legal-principle/scenario-analysis organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes an essay analyzing a legal scenario, applying due process, punishment theory, and civil/criminal distinctions

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay applies at least two genuine legal concepts from this unit with specific reasoning
misconception_flags: essay states a personal opinion on the scenario's outcome without applying any legal concept from this unit

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
